e: Elongated form of fu, a clipping of fuck. The specific elongation length was coined on Reddit in December 2008, in reference to rage comics on 4chan earlier in 2008. 7 "F"s and 12 "U"s are used as a reference to the /r/fffffffuuuuuuuuuuuu subreddit or its community. The term is sometimes shortened to f7u12.
q: "Fffffffuuuuuuuuuuuu!" I yell. It hurts my ears.
New semester starting, all I have to say is: FFFFFFFUUUUUUUUUUUU
